clips.title: The story
paras: In northeastern the Barrens, Sludge Fen's clear pool has become an oily industrial field run by the Venture Company. Supervisor Lugwizzle oversees the drilling, while rivals in Ratchet seek to sabotage the operation.

Sludge Fen once held a clear pool fed by natural springs in the arid Barrens. The Venture Company built oil-drilling platforms and machinery over the basin, turning the wetland into a reservoir of sludge and industrial waste. Supervisor Lugwizzle oversees goblin drillers, engineers, and overseers as they pump crude oil around the clock. Runoff and toxic byproducts coat the water, choking the native aquatic life beneath the grease.
